doc.summary: Model Context Protocol server for LazyOwnInfiniteStorage.
doc.description:
Exposes stdio tools so an agent can run the full zip -> video pipeline and the
inverse video -> zip pipeline with easy to remember English commands.

name: TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS
value: {'lazyown_zip_to_video': 'Zip a file or directory then encode the archive into a video. Full pipeline: source -> zip -> video. Parameters: source_path, output_video, frame_size ("W H"), fps, block_size, protocol.', 'lazyown_video_to_zip': 'Decode a video into a zip archive then extract it into a directory. Inverse pipeline: video -> zip -> extracted files. Parameters: input_video, output_dir, block_size, protocol.', 'lazyown_encode': 'Encode a single file into a video. Parameters: input_file, output_file, frame_size ("W H"), fps, block_size, protocol.', 'lazyown_decode': 'Decode a video back into the original file. Parameters: input_file, output_file, block_size, protocol.', 'lazyown_create_zip': 'Create a zip archive from a file or directory. Parameters: source_path, output_zip.', 'lazyown_extract_zip': 'Safely extract a zip archive into a directory (blocks zip slip). Parameters: zip_path, output_dir.'}

doc.summary: Entry point for the LazyOwnInfiniteStorage MCP stdio server.
